what: A collapsed side table of contents for articles — each section shows only a short horizontal dash (2px, 8~22px depending on the section name length) on an 8px line, and the dash of the section currently being read (section head past the top 30% of the screen) lengthens by 8px and darkens to the text color. Hovering the TOC extends the lines to 22px and the 12px section names turn on almost instantly (.017~.033s) in place of the dashes, and on leave the names slide out 8px to the left and turn off in .133s while the lines collapse again in .167s. A long-form TOC pinned at the vertical center of the screen

options.[data-fx-part=label]: Section name inside the line (shows on hover)
options.at: Point that counts as the current section (ScrollTrigger start), default ‹top 30%›
options.grow: Amount (px) the section dash grows longer by, default 8
options.--fx-row · --fx-row-open: Collapsed and expanded line heights (css variables), default 8px · 22px

note: The original dash length rule could not be read from the bundle, so it is set proportional to the Section name length (adjust with min · max)

from.where: article.html .as-toc — sticky left table of contents for a research article
